audit.why: Content already states Maokai favoured all 7 stages (win rate 46.62%, packet levelChart all Maokai) — CC-less Yuumi has no answer to a point-and-click dash-root.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0-6].side all say "Skill", contradicting content win[] (Maokai all 7 rows) and the packet levelChart.
audit.why: The full-layer chart renders as a neutral even matchup while the content layer says Maokai wins every stage — the two answer "who wins Level 1" differently.
audit.corrected: Set all 7 full phases[].side to Maokai, with why text grounded in Twisted Advance's dash-root and Nature's Grasp's cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Twisted Advance as matchup-defining but carries no cooldown number.
audit.why: Real numbers make the advice actionable — Twisted Advance is 14/13/12/11/10s by rank.
audit.corrected: Add the cooldown range to the field.

edits.before: Poke from the saddle — the attached Q steers and the lane can't bill you for it.
edits.after: His W (525 range) already threatens the level-1 skirmish and you have zero CC to peel a point-and-click root.

edits.before: Dismount windows begin: the passive autos shield and heal; schedule them carefully.
edits.after: A landed Twisted Advance chunks your ADC through Q's knockback follow-up — your E shield rarely covers the whole combo.

edits.before: Full rhythm: attach for the trades, dismount for the passive, never linger between.
edits.after: Sapling Toss (E) zones your poke windows while he sustains off passive — you're on defense, not trading.

edits.before: Zoomies the margins — the host's tempo is your tempo; bank the chip.
edits.after: Root-into-Q picks whenever your ADC steps up — W is still down to 11-10s at this level.

edits.before: Final Chapter online — the root waves referee every dive on your host.
edits.after: Nature's Grasp (R, 130/110/90s) adds a lane-wide root that chains into W — Final Chapter heals but never breaks the lock.

edits.before: First item: the heals compound and the steered Qs chunk.
edits.after: His tank durability plus sapling zoning still wins the poke war even after your first item lands.

edits.before: Late Yuumi is the unkillable second health bar: attach, amplify, and out-vote the focus fire.
edits.after: Two items deep he's a near-unkillable engage tank whose W deletes your positioning outright.

edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root): matchup-defining — Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W attach (untargetability) answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root, 14-10s cooldown): matchup-defining — point-and-click root, count it before stepping up. - Your W attach (untargetability) answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.

edits.before: Steer the Q through the pair, E the trade-back, auto from the passive window — billed, healed, and re-saddled.
edits.after: Land Q through both targets, E the retaliation, then auto during the passive window for a fully healed trade.

edits.before: Lingering dismounted for one more auto — the cat on foot is the game's most honest kill.
edits.after: One extra auto while dismounted is how yuumi players die — remount before you take it.
